name: PizzaExpress
covers: Dishes, drinks and breakfast in PizzaExpress restaurants in England, Scotland, Wales and Jersey
headline: Pizzas and pasta: ask for the GF base or pasta.
tips: Pizzas and pasta: ask for the GF base or GF fusilli. PizzaExpress says those dishes then suit coeliacs; the GF base is served with a purple pizza slicer.
Dough balls: ask for GF dough balls. Gelato: without the wafer.
Coffee: any milk but oat drink. The guide ticks the oat drink for coeliacs, but this app counts oats as gluten.
gaps: PizzaExpress says its gluten free dishes are accredited by Coeliac UK. Its own words are on the Warnings page; this app lists what it ticks for coeliacs, and quotes each change it asks for.
The guide says the accreditation doesn't apply to delivery orders, which are handled by a third party.
An asterisk in the guide means an ingredient is made where gluten is present; those items are on the Avoid list here.
Create Your Own and Duo Romana: the guide says it can't guarantee any allergen or dietary requirements for them.
